name: intermittent_particle_load
description: A fault that is not there most of the time. The scenario contract has carried `profile: intermittent` since v1 and the envelope has been implemented since Step 3A, and no library scenario has ever used it — an untested branch in the shape a fault takes in time, which is precisely the dimension the diagnosis engine is supposed to reason about. A polish chamber sheds particles in bursts on a three-day period at a 45% duty cycle, with a drawn phase so the bursts do not begin on the onset tick. Every statistic in the registry contrasts a segment before a change point with a segment after it, and a duty-cycled fault raises the *mean* of the later segment while raising its *variance* more, which is the case a two-sample contrast is weakest at and a trend fit does not describe either. It is also the only fault in the library on a CMP tool.
